content: फु(फू)त् {%ind.%} An onomatopoetic word generally used in composition with कृ, and imitative of the sound made by blowing into liquids <ab>&c.</ab>; sometimes it expresses disregard or contempt; फु(फू)त्कृ .²1 To blow into (a liquid); बालः पायसदग्धो दध्यपि फूत्कृत्य भक्षयति <ls>H. 4. 103</ls>. .²2 To scream aloud, cry, shriek.
